name: Fit check
source: library: a recurring fashion format, described generically
essence: The whole range revealed in a fast run of cuts timed to a beat, each piece filling the frame for half a second, then one confident landing on where to get it.
why_it_works: Speed rewards rewatching: people loop it to see each piece
No reading needed in the first second
The landing frame turns attention into a visit

hook.pattern: a two-word lowercase label, e.g. 'fit check' or '{place} edition'
hook.first_frame: the boldest piece, full frame, already moving

sound: an upbeat trending track around 120 BPM; cuts land on the beat
keep: cut rhythm locked to a beat
one piece per cut, full frame
drop: any creator's face, outfit or audio
